Close the game, select its running launcher and installed executable, choose launch priorities and a core mask, accept the launcher scope, and review the settings. **Arm session** starts the worker; launch the game normally after it reports Ready. GPU access denial remains unavailable; it does not prevent other accepted controls from being shown individually. When Windows opens the pick but can't name it as a file, such as a named pipe, the review is refused and says why. Saved launch settings turn on only for the reviewed path; the `\\?\` and `\\?\UNC\` spellings of a path count as the same path. Settings an earlier version saved with a path through a link or mapped drive, or a short 8.3 name, don't turn on: their row says where Windows now finds the game and asks you to turn them off and set the game up again.
